title: Detail: capture sharpening and noise reduction
objective: Deliver a deterministic, bounded Detail module with pre-tone capture sharpening and manual noise reduction on RAW/JPEG, exact settled Fit, shared masks/presets/history and photographic/native M4 evidence.
context_summary: Planning only. Choices are delegated by the owner on 2026-09-30 and recorded in docs/decisions.md and docs/design/detail.md; no owner-review prerequisite and no implementation authorized by this planning request. Defaults: restoration before Basic/Presence, denoise then sharpen, zero strengths, scaled approximate motion and exact-derived settled Fit. Current host contracts require extensions for source-pixel scale, Fit presentation and off-owner pre-tone pixel queries. Numerical coefficients, controlled photographs and cost remain unqualified until these tasks prove them. Preserve current formats only; no output sharpening, AI/profiled denoise or new capabilities. Listed test filters are to be added by their tasks; commands use existing tools. Use fresh evidence output paths for reruns.

tasks.description: Freeze the Detail numerical contract and reproducible quality corpus.
extra_context: Product choices are delegated and recorded; do not add an owner-review gate. This study resolves coefficient mappings and evidence, not processing order or scope.
Use bounded three-level B-spline shrinkage in extended Oklab followed by edge-gated unsharp masking. No AI, profile lookup, new dependency or whole-frame opponent buffer.
Keep this task numerical and photographic; photo-sized timing waits until the finished feature. Missing authentic scenes are an explicit qualification gap, never a substituted pass.

acceptance_criteria: A short numerical study freezes all eight field mappings, signed/HDR conversion, thresholds and edge protection, Gaussian limiter, per-axis fractional proxy taps and rounding, true-edge rules, and peak-live scratch formulae.
Denoise and sharpen halos are proven at most 24 and 16 full-resolution pixels respectively; neutral components bypass conversion and work exactly.

Independent reference fixtures cover identity, constants, noise, slanted edges, chroma boundaries, negative/HDR values, tiny/odd images and seams. Freeze float/quantization tolerances before production, initially the design's 1e-6 absolute/relative and one terminal code.

A hashed/provenanced corpus names Z6, X100VI, Air 2S and photographic JPEGs, clean/noisy references, ISO/settings, inspection crops and fixed parameter sets, with missing coverage explicitly recorded.

The designated moderate-setting synthetic gates measure at least 25% flat-patch RMS reduction, less than one-code mean drift, and at least 10% sharpening MTF50 improvement with at most 5% edge-contrast overshoot/undershoot; record photographic failure cases, not only aggregate scores.

steps: Build independent references and synthetic fixtures; inspect matched photographic crops at 100% and final output size.
Record a reproducible gate report and freeze coefficients before production kernels; tune within selected support and scope if cases fail.
expected_results: Reference fixtures and numerical study agree; every required scene is present or recorded incomplete.

acceptance_criteria: Restoration inserts after the leading source/pixel prefix and before the first colour/spatial/geometry/finish layer; new pixel/colour edits respect it and RAW stays index zero. Existing interleaved pixel/colour layers stay in stored order without rewriting. Placement tests cover creation permutations, a pixel proof after colour and mask ranks.
One compilation context carries exact stage, evaluated stage and per-axis scale to modules on full, proxy and region paths; no module-name switch or duplicate pipeline is introduced.
A generic opt-in settled-Fit-from-exact declaration is validated/discoverable and aggregation depends on active compiled operations, so neutral Detail has no preview overhead.

Basic neutral patches and all newly expensive pixel-reading query paths run off-owner on immutable evaluations with bounded queue/cache, preserved entry/revision identity, disconnect handling and stale-apply refusal. Sensor WB retains its current contract.
Range-mask input and overlay planning is audited for the earlier spatial prefix; existing explicit cost refusal stays honest. Planning and field validation perform no pixel work.

steps: Use a test provider to prove insertion, context scale and neutral policy aggregation on JPEG/RAW.
Hold a query worker evaluation and prove another client remains responsive; exercise a stale answer and queue/cancellation failures.
expected_results: Shared host can express Detail without changing existing recipes or blocking the owner.

acceptance_criteria: Both units match independent references on exact and proxy grids at the frozen tolerances, including signed/HDR and near-black/saturated inputs without intermediate clipping.
Neutral strengths omit their units; constants and identities retain exact buffers. Denoise precedes sharpen without intermediate quantization.
Full/sample and region/full results match byte for byte on both domains; repeated runs, supported tile cuts and serial/pool execution are deterministic, with correct borders and halos.

Scratch accounts for all concurrently live planes/bands/guide storage with overflow checks, reserve-before-allocate and cleanup on cancel/error/panic; operation halo stays at most 40 px and units at most two.
Cancellation checkpoints bound each pass/row chunk; no full-frame mask, opponent image or per-scale full-frame buffer is allocated.

steps: Run frozen fixtures through production and the independent reference, exercising each field alone and extrema together.
Use deterministic cancellation gates and constrained scratch targets to test cleanup and single-tile progress.
expected_results: Kernels satisfy exactness and allocation contracts; no photographic or speed claim inferred from small fixtures.

acceptance_criteria: Fit motion uses source-scale-aware kernels on display proxies; 100%+ motion uses half-scale visible regions. Detail approximation reasons coexist with thin-mask and RAW-WB reasons.

On quiet/release, active policy stacks present a bounded downsample of the exact final rendered output at Fit, tagged exact-derived; full-resolution drafted RAW WB remains marked approximate. Counts retain whole-image exact provenance.
History/presets/Compare, mask edits, other controls, crop, resize, display density and return to Fit trigger the matching settlement; inactive policy does not add work.
Scale/window/recipe/draft/development identity reaches cache, frame, overlays and state; a newer input cancels or rejects every stale exact/downsample/upload completion.
Region/full and window/whole equality, chained spatial layers and cold Dehaze estimates are tested; unsupported cuts report and measure their fallback rather than presenting it as a region success.
Reuse latest queue, quiet timer, frame limits and aggregate texture caps; no full-frame clone or permanent polling; idle returns to sleep.

steps: Prove reducer reference equality and scheduling races with test providers and gated jobs.
Add native background capture coverage for moving-to-settled Fit, percentage zoom and no stale draws, to be run with the real Detail module at integration.
expected_results: Settled Fit includes full-resolution processing, and every approximation and fallback remains observable.

acceptance_criteria: Gradient/radial/brush/range masks, amount/inversion, overlaps and reorder preserve host blend semantics: zero input equality, full unmasked equality, no tile/mask-boundary seams or stored edge-mask plane.
Range-mask rendering reads each layer input; first-bound overlay changes invalidate correctly or return the documented cost refusal. No circular evaluation or wrong-stage coverage.

Native preset capture/export/import/apply round-trips all eight fields, zero strengths and inactive settings; masks remain untouched and one apply is one entry. Unsupported Lightroom keys are individually reported.
Independent API and UI journeys prove partial patch/retry/revision/conflict behaviour, reset/no-op, undo/redo/Restore/versions, historical preview and fresh-owner reopen.
RAW white-balance changes invalidate dependent pixels; Detail sliders cause no redevelopment. JPEG and RAW retain their declared quantization/headroom boundaries.

Original hashes remain unchanged; missing/disabled Detail, unsupported format or corrupt input retains data and refuses affected outputs. Export consumes exact Detail once, never a proxy or a second output-sharpen pass.

steps: Add current-shape integration fixtures and failure injection; compare exact raster buffers before JPEG encoding rather than using lossy JPEG equality as an oracle.
Check full Detail+Basic+Presence+geometry stacks and independent client/desktop requests against the same snapshot.
expected_results: All integrations preserve source/history data and share one rendering/mutation service.

Compare no-Detail and Detail on 24/60 MP JPEG and authentic Z6/X100VI/Air 2S RAW, each strength/all fields, overlapping masks and Detail+Basic+Presence/Dehaze+crop; include exact-fallback cases.

The full performance-rules checklist is answered with evidence and scope, without a total-memory or speed guarantee inferred from synthetic fixtures.
